newsitem.title: EU: EP ECONOMIC COMMITTEE AGENDA - APRIL 14-15.
newsitem.headline: EP ECONOMIC COMMITTEE AGENDA - APRIL 14-15.

text.p: Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs and Industrial Policy [[ Monday 14 April 1997 ]] SUBCOMMITTEE ON MONETARY AFFAIRS 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE222.183 ) 2. Chairman's announcements 3. Current monetary situation: Bulletin 4/April 1997 4. Joint hearing of experts with the Committee on Legal Affairs and Citizens' Rights and the Committee on the Environment, Public Health and Consumer Protection on the Euro and the consumer - Introductory statements followed by exchange of views - please see separate programme ===] Tuesday 15 April 1997 morning 5. Meeting with Mr DE MICHELIS, Director, Eurostat, on progress towards the harmonisation of indicators of economic convergence (9-10 a.m.) - Introductory statement 6. Meeting with Mr ZALM, Dutch Minister of Finance, on monetary questions relating to the Amsterdam summit (10-11.30 a.m.) - Introductory statement 7. Stability pact to ensure budgetary discipline in 3rd stage of EMU (T05039) **II SYN96247 COM(97)0116 C4-0576/96 CNS96248 COM(97)0117 C4-0577/96 + ECON Fond R CHRISTODOULOU Efthym (PPE) - Exchange of views 8. Statement on the recent IMF conference on the international dimension of the Euro - Mr RUFFOLO 9. International dimension of the Euro (SNA0184 ) (PE221.838 ) - Rapporteur: Mr RUFFOLO - Exchange of views 10. Any other business 11. Date of next meeting (PE/IV/OJ/97-06/MONE ) END OF DOCUMENT.
